description: Register an explicit bundle id (App ID) in the Apple Developer account, the first step for a brand-new app before its app record and signing profile, and turn on its capabilities (push notifications, iCloud, Sign in with Apple and the rest). Idempotent: an existing identifier is returned, not an error, and capabilities already on are left alone. Without confirm:true it only checks and says what it would do. Pro feature.

capabilities.description: Apple capability types to turn on, e.g. ["PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS", "ICLOUD", "APPLE_ID_AUTH"]. Works on a new or an existing bundle id. In-App Purchase is already on for every explicit id.

confirm.description: Required to write. Registers the identifier and/or turns on the capabilities on your Apple Developer account.

identifier.description: Explicit reverse-DNS bundle id, e.g. app.example.ios (no wildcard)

name.description: Portal name: letters, digits and spaces only

name: register_bundle_id
title: Register a bundle id
